verdict.rationale: All Pulumi MCP evidence describes Pulumi acting as an MCP *server* (exposing its own tools to external AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf) — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Pulumi itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers as a client. Even Pulumi Neo, the AI agent component, is only documented as executing infrastructure changes from plain-English prompts, with no evidence it can attach to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
